newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books to acquire Shari Lewis.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books to acquire Shari Lewis.

text.p: Golden Books Family Entertainment said Wednesday that it will acquire all outstanding stock of privately-held Shari Lewis Enterprises Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The company said that in adddition to acquiring the Shari Lewis library, which includes books, television specials, films amd home videos, it will receive distribution fees for Shari Lewis programs and a percentage of adjusted gross revenues.
It will make its debut in television distribution this January with a new 40-episode series based on a Shari Lewis character, Charley Horse.
Shari Lewis is a children's entertainer whose puppet characters, Lamb Chop, Hush Puppy and Charley Horse, have formed the basis of Shari Lewis Enterprises Inc.
Golden Books is a publisher of children's books.
